author: China Insights
description:
A New Mexico drone incursion remained unhindered for five days over U.S. military airspace. We examine the timeline of this breach and the official response.

For five days in the spring of 2025, an unidentified aerial vehicle entered US military airspace without facing immediate intervention. While authorities eventually apprehended individuals connected to a rented camper van linked to the drone intrusion, the incident has raised significant questions regarding regional monitoring capabilities.

This update details the sequence of events, from the initial sightings to the detainment of the suspects involved. We look at how this breach of national security was handled on the ground and the resulting investigation into those responsible.

description:
A massive crash at the China GT race in Shanghai left a driver trapped in a burning Ferrari for more than a minute. With no official rescue team immediately on scene, fellow racer Loek Hartog stopped his own car, ran into the fire, and pulled him out.
What happened next raised even bigger questions about emergency response, race safety, and allegations that officials tried to shift blame after the crash.
